Rule: No text from Settings → Broken Values on the tab, the breakdown or the unit window
The centre of every row button (unit code, ⊞ Breakdown, Edit) and every filter is the button itself, not something on top of it (e.g. the reminder cards)
At every Layout Width the page itself does not scroll sideways (the table may scroll inside its own box)
Column groups span exactly the columns under them
Every amount in Exact view is "$" + digits with thousands commas; every % is "+N%", "-N%" or "0%"
